title: Spread geometric irreducibility for an affine source with affine target image
statement: Let X be an affine scheme and f:X→T a locally finite type morphism whose image lies in an affine open V of T. Let η be a generic point of T, and suppose X_η is geometrically irreducible. There exists an open U of T containing η such that every fibre X_t for t in U is geometrically irreducible. No global quasi-compactness of the open immersion V→T is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0559, second proof, affine-source case; Tags 0557 and 054X.

proof.text: Use the radicial reduced model to obtain an integral affine base and a reduced flat locally finitely presented affine source with geometrically reduced generic fibre. Transfer geometric irreducibility of the generic fibre using the model's pointwise equivalence.
Choose the spreading affine chart in this model. It is generically geometrically irreducible because its base neighbourhood contains the generic point.

Apply geometric fibre density to the chart and intersect its neighbourhood with the chart's irreducibility neighbourhood. After any residue-field extension the dense chart is irreducible. Its continuous image has irreducible closure, which is the full fibre, proving geometric irreducibility of that fibre.

The base universal homeomorphism takes the intersection open to an open of the original base neighbourhood. Include this open in T. Its image contains the generic point. For a point in it, choose its preimage and apply the model's pointwise equivalence to descend geometric fibre irreducibility.

theorem exists_open_affine_source_geometric_irreducibility_shrink
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (V : T.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (himage : Set.range f ⊆ V)
    (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ U : T.Opens, η ∈ U ∧ ∀ t, t ∈ U →
      GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField t)
